Standard **Flonase** (fluticasone nasal spray) has ` [Highlight start] no known direct interaction with alcohol [Highlight end] ` , so drinking alcohol in moderation is generally considered safe.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESswEBxCJF1yWSBsjow69LO3oUUBttzKtogktDcVvp5YpxG54793kSoFLg-peyCVkd0EAGfVTWbzC_GSK9l8SN88dDRWzhnVeBA2T5QtibtamlNAagoy3_2A0lFjGAfMS3sF8YKT3ddBoWWUMG5xSO3NrToXtwZa9RkphFZ-mWz812mn_-048NdlHngyQnxi2Vm9Z2mPF1VxTK4FSc-6QmBn9QGhEvz_gZ5TvmWoTrW53aFwmgUQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXX7VNeBoD8I1J9ZwuDVr5xkQWNVmvJ1HtunMq4gXS0i8KEkaIljP-O1s2PzCY5vrXNQ9NkNIK4AcYhI33jPvzqundt8BtgB9gxxlb2LF2y2HAzWFCWIh6Ot2Ok_So)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF13pBHVqg8i0jXE6lizxVrHseUzBN6fphZx821dkAbCn-4VbMReGgxVdAgOQYSBsTK6SXMrHQUUP3y1Huv6TxlHbbhV1DTeNuYAn0nuzcmLtdCZqDEg5LgZ6oA9TEjmMRQ4K94Cynllxohjb_qYIf7gnIciJvGJA19RQ83PTzW_QCDs-u0R8)

- **Combination sprays:** Some nasal sprays combine fluticasone with an antihistamine like azelastine, which can cause drowsiness and increase sedative effects when mixed with alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF141f50WXWNa0GT-e00F0zuyzJ1bVpFwfuVIZBwCW-e6FS3ZESZerXkMhwyeOxSCy_MgRa45IgVAd6rQANVWBPHhWcfQQ1ddsU-CBos-CI8zl2ZqdxL0ZZ7fY3MbbvX1PtpfF7rN4OkmhqteskcpqCoXNNq5Lx3ZRMb9HOVqS6bU)
- **Oral multi-symptom products:** Oral products (such as certain headache or allergy relief tablets) may contain ingredients like acetaminophen or sedating antihistamines that carry serious alcohol warnings, such as liver strain or heightened drowsiness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF16OA7yPtScjIKR031g01YTO3b3VPv-7Bt7aBzyrBFHp6U1v8xY_zk2huV9Q5MyYTYyAnln6CfLG8ToCilLES9QiBVSKbcmDbgvZKEM_jRuFfePK3V_KyH3Bpf9gevKZVzWbO7YLeNZZW8H_C3nQ2W-UEgXtQR2pX-8JjLV7KwTIaWQ)
